structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router._internal.capabilities.tools import (
    ToolCall,
    ToolExecutionError,
    ToolRegistry,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_TOOL_REGISTRY[revision==1]")
def test_execute_raises_tool_execution_error_on_callable_failure() -> None:
    expected_error = RuntimeError("Execution failed")

    def failing_tool(value: int) -> int:
        raise expected_error

    registry = ToolRegistry.from_tools([failing_tool])
    call = ToolCall(name="failing_tool", args={"value": 42}, id="call_1")

    with pytest.raises(ToolExecutionError) as exc_info:
        registry.execute(call)

    assert exc_info.value.tool_name == "failing_tool"
    assert exc_info.value.args == {"value": 42}
    assert exc_info.value.cause is expected_error
    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is expected_error
